_comment: HTTP 400 Bad Request. TrainingPeaks returns an error envelope with 'error' and 'error_description'. Common triggers: a workouts date range exceeding 45 days, a WorkoutDay more than 7 days in the past or 1 year in the future on a plan write, or a dead refresh_token on /oauth/token.

_documented_write_constraints.WorkoutDay: cannot exceed 7 days past or 1 year future; the time component is ignored
_documented_write_constraints.workouts_range: date range max 45 days; end date max 365 days in the future
_documented_write_constraints.structure_overrides: when a valid non-RPE Structure is uploaded, TotalTimePlanned / TSSPlanned / IFPlanned are IGNORED and recomputed from the structure
